description: This file defines the Currency class in the OpenCart system, providing functionalities for currency formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency attributes such as symbols, IDs, and decimal places.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class managing currency data, formatting, and conversion in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency object by fetching all currency records from the database and storing them internally.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a numerical value into a currency string based on currency settings, including symbols and decimal places.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value from one currency to another using stored exchange rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a given currency.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the left symbol associated with a currency.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Retrieves the right symbol associated with a currency.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Gets the number of decimal places used for a currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate value for a currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a currency exists in the internal currency list.
